transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess... my mind just keeps going blank. It happens at the worst times. Like, I'll look at the road-closure forms at work, or just be holding my stop-slow paddle, and suddenly I can't remember the steps. Things I've done for years. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Do these blank moments seem to happen when you're under a lot of stress or pressure?
I don't know. I haven't really thought about it like that. It just... happens.
Do you think stress might be playing a role in when these blank moments happen?
I... I don't really know. Like I said, I haven't noticed if it's stress. It just happens.
Do you have trouble remembering things when you're not at work?

I... I don't know. Like I said, it's mostly just... my mind goes completely blank. I'll be looking at something I've done for years, and the steps just aren't there anymore. I guess I just notice it the most with the forms and my paddle... I don't really keep track of it at home.
Do you ever have trouble remembering things that are not related to your job?
I'm not sure. I haven't really... paid attention to that. I just notice it at work because... I need to know what to do. At home, I guess it doesn't matter as much.
Do you have trouble remembering things that you do regularly at home?

I... I mean, I don't really know about home. Like I was saying, I mostly just know I came in because my mind keeps going blank at the worst times. I'll just be standing there with the stop-slow paddle, or looking at the road-closure forms... and I suddenly can't remember the steps to do it. Things I've done for years. That's... that's what I'm dealing with.
Do these blank moments in your mind happen after something upsetting or emotional occurs?
I... no. I don't think so. It just happens. I haven't really noticed it being tied to... anything like that. It just comes out of nowhere.
Have you been feeling anxious or depressed lately?

I guess... depressed, maybe. It's just... most mornings I wake up and there's this heavy, hollow feeling in my chest. Like a sadness. It just feels like the day is already ruined before I even get out of bed.
Have you been feeling anxious lately?
No... I don't think so. Not really anxious. Just... just what I said before.
How long have you been waking up with that heavy, hollow feeling in your chest?
I don't know... a while. Maybe... a year? A year and a couple of months, I think. It's just... been there.
Have you been experiencing any feelings of worry or fear that you can't control?
No. Just... no. I don't think so.
Do you find yourself avoiding certain situations or tasks because of these blank moments?

Yes. I... I stopped being able to do things. At work, I couldn't finish the road-closure paperwork. I didn't trust myself with the traffic-safety steps anymore. I just... I stopped going to choir. I stopped volunteering. I pulled away from my family. I guess... that's why they felt they had to bring me here.
Has something very upsetting or traumatic happened to you in the past that might be connected to when these blank moments started?
I... yeah. I suppose so. It's been about... a year and eight months. That's when my... my closest friend died. I guess that's when it started. I don't really want to talk about that part.
Do the blank moments happen when you're reminded of your friend who passed away?
I... I don't know. I haven't really noticed if it's connected like that. I just try not to think about it at all. So... I'm not sure.
Did the blank moments start happening around the same time your friend passed away?
I... yeah. Like I said before, I think so. It was around then. I don't really remember the exact timeline. I just... I don't know. I don't really want to focus on that.
Do you think trying not to think about your friend who passed away might be contributing to these blank moments?
I... I don't know. Maybe. I just... I really don't like talking about this. I don't know why it happens.
Have you been experiencing these blank moments and the heavy, hollow feeling in your chest for more than 6 months?
I... yeah, it's been longer than that. The... the heavy feeling, the guilt, and just having no energy... not wanting to eat... it's been about a year and two months now.
Have you been feeling depressed, with the heavy, hollow feeling in your chest, for most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two weeks at any point in the past year?

I... yeah. It's been most days. I just... most mornings, I wake up with that heavy, hollow sadness in my chest. It just feels like... like the day is already ruined before I even put my feet on the floor. So, yes.
Have you had any periods of at least two months in the past year where you didn't feel this heavy, hollow sadness in your chest?
I... no. I don't think so. It hasn't really gone away.
Have you had at least two weeks in a row where you felt depressed most of the day?
I... yeah. Like I just said, it's been most days. So... yes, definitely two weeks in a row.
